text:
maya: Quick announce — Conduit Edge streaming is GA for hosted regions (us-west/us-east/eu). Targets low-latency mobile + edge clients. Docs: https://redwood.dev/conduit-edge

maya: New models: conduit-edge-3b, conduit-edge-8b-int4. New endpoint: POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/conduit/edge/stream (supports sync, stream, tool-calls).

ash: Heads-up for integrators: default data_retention now defaults to "ephemeral" for edge streams. Customers who need logs must opt-in via org settings. See security note below.

devx-bot: SDK updates published: node@4.1.0 (edge stream helpers), python@3.9.0 (async client wrappers). Mobile examples added under /clients/edge-examples.

ops_oncall: Rollout plan: staged 4h by org. Prewarm enabled for top-10 orgs. Monitoring: we will track stream connect rate and tail P95. Ping #eng-runtime for hotfixes.

security: We added short-lived stream tokens for edge. Streams must send X-Edge-TTL header. No change to training policy (no training on hosted data). If customers require retention >30d, route to Private/Dedicated.

maya: Migration window: legacy /v1/conduit/generate endpoints supported for 60 days. Canary keys available — DM me.

deploy-bot: deploy: hosted/conduit/edge-gateway v1.0.0 deployed by CI at 2026-09-01T15:12:03Z — gradual roll starting.

maya: Thanks team — immediate next steps: devx publish mobile snippets, infra confirm proxy header passthrough, security verify token rotation tests. Tag follow-ups with conduit-edge-ga.
